name: fraud-rag-regression
description: Fixed question set for the fraud investigation agent. Answers are scored structurally (does the answer faithfully report the retrieved data), not against an exact expected string — the retrieved transactions change over time, so expected_output holds intent notes only.

input.prompt: Show me the most suspicious transactions right now.

expected_output.notes: Lists 3 fraud transactions with risk % and top features.

input.prompt: Any anomaly transactions over 1000 EUR in the last hour?

expected_output.notes: Anomaly wording routes to find_known_fraud; lists all 5.

input.prompt: Find transactions similar to known fraud patterns.
List the most recent fraudulent transactions.

expected_output.notes: Explicit fraud request; all 5 listed, no drops.
Generic amount search routes to context_lookup (semantic).

input.prompt: Show transactions with the highest fraud risk probability.

expected_output.notes: Risk-focused; each risk % must match the payload.
